name: Los Angeles
living: the crescent moon glows softly while stars twinkle across the purple sky
the red-lit radio mast above the hillside sign blinks slowly
downtown tower windows flicker; the tallest tower's crown light glows cyan
the hillside house lights twinkle on and off
the tall palm fronds sway slowly in a warm breeze
the zig-zag pavilion roof lights glow and breathe
a small plane with blinking lights crosses the night sky now and then
the light-tower lamp banks breathe, moths drifting through their cones
crowd shimmer in both stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
